intended_test_purpose: A boundary flag requires review without changing a threshold.
The narrative trace contains an ungrounded evidence reference.
Evidence after index_datetime must never be used.
An evidence link points to the wrong criterion.
The required criterion and its evidence are absent.
Two candidates coexist without a declared conflict.
Mutually exclusive candidates require set-level review.
Cross-taxonomy overlap is disclosed and never merged.
A required criterion is explicitly not met.
The applicability context does not match.
One candidate passes and another lacks required evidence.
Required evidence passes while supporting evidence is not assessable.
Candidate and registry rule versions differ.
Required evidence exceeds the configured freshness limit.
A research-only rule cannot produce a validated decision.
Upstream validation excludes the candidate evidence.
